summary: Added 66 adversarial probes (4 new test files, 1172 lines) covering XFF spoofing / header-bomb / malformed IPs / IPv6 / TRUST_PROXY_COUNT edge cases; rate-limit boundary probes (5th attempt, 6th attempt, ms-precise window expiry via vi.useFakeTimers, empty + 1000-char identifiers, atomic increment path under concurrent recordFailure, resetLimit no-op, captcha threshold + reset + bucket-independence); cleanup adversarial probes (empty table, strict less-than cutoff, mixed old/recent rows, concurrent lock collision, batch boundaries 999/1000/1001/2500); and fast-path dual-gate probes (NODE_ENV × RATE_LIMIT_INMEMORY_FASTPATH truth table, source-inspection guard, README dual-gate artifact cross-check). All probes pass; 89/89 scoped auth tests green, 28/28 scoped API tests green. No production code modified.

anti_patterns_defended.A4_vacuous_pass: All probes assert labeled boolean/int values (e.g. `expect(result.allowed).toBe(false)`), not 'something happened'.
anti_patterns_defended.A5_false_claim: No probe claims 'all checks pass' in source comments — each probe is a single falsifiable assertion. The README dual-gate cross-check is an existence probe only, not a claim of operator understanding.
anti_patterns_defended.A7_over_broad_filter: All XFF probes target the exact TRUST_PROXY_COUNT value being tested; no English-keyword filter swallows real hits.
anti_patterns_defended.changed_contract_risk_CR1: Boundary probes use the SHIPPED `{ allowed, retriesAfter, captchaRequired }` contract, NOT the spec's proposed `{ allowed, remaining, retryAfterMs }`. The header comment of rate-limit-adversarial.test.ts documents this explicitly.
anti_patterns_defended.test_inflation: All 66 probes are independent — no two probes test the same input/output. Captcha bucket-independence has 4 separate probes for clarity, not for inflation.

notes_for_final_acceptance: The 66 new adversarial probes complement (not replace) the existing 23 happy-path rate-limit unit tests. After this commit, the auth package has 47 rate-limit-related tests across 6 files (rate-limit, rate-limit-store, rate-limit-cleanup, rate-limit-captcha, wave0-phase2-architecture, rate-limit-readme) plus 47 new adversarial probes.

Two previously-untested behaviors are now pinned: (a) the atomic increment() path under concurrent recordFailure (rate-limit-adversarial.test.ts), and (b) the millisecond-precise strict-greater-than window-expiry boundary (rate-limit-adversarial.test.ts with vi.useFakeTimers).

The captchaRequired independence probes establish that the username bucket is the source of truth for captchaRequired on the user-facing check, while the IP bucket retains its own count — this matches the JSDoc contract at rate-limit.ts:319-341 and pins the behavior against a future refactor that could leak IP state into the username response.

The fast-path adversarial probes (rate-limit-fastpath-adversarial.test.ts) include source-inspection guards that defend against a future refactor that hides the dual gate behind a helper — both halves of the gate (NODE_ENV AND RATE_LIMIT_INMEMORY_FASTPATH) must remain spelled out in the boolean expression.

No production code was modified. The probes pass against the SHIPPED implementation at the baseline SHA, confirming that the existing rate-limiter v2 implementation satisfies all adversarial scenarios probed.
